_meta_itemized.notes: RE-FILE: this Post-Election report is Glenn Wright's Pre-Election sheet (8191) submitted again UNCHANGED - the same 5 contribution lines, the same 5 expenditure lines, the same boxed totals, and a cover whose 'Total from last report' column still reads $0.00 rather than carrying the 1,180.17 forward. Transcribed independently from its own pages; the identical figures are the source's behaviour, not a duplicate-transcription error, and the two documents are separate filings in index.csv. The only physical differences from 8191 are scan artifacts (a stray rule near the top of p2 that rowbands picks up as band 1, shifting the contribution rows to bands 3-7, and p3's vertical rules too faint to detect - the ROW rules on p3 detect cleanly, so its geometry is still measured). Typed sheets; the embedded OCR layer garbles the amount column, so every figure comes from the full-page image read. Mailing addresses and zip codes are printed by the FILER and are discarded at read time under the privacy rule (no county redaction on this filing). Same 2018 split50 in-kind shape as 8191: in-kind entered inline and counted inside the schedule's single printed total.
